$comment: Standard JSON has no // comments. Property descriptions in this schema are the canonical field comments for Route Model profiles.

logical_elements_per_system_cycle.description: Effective source-level atomic elements processed per system-cycle selection score.

single_physical_program_logical_elements.description: Optional effective atomic rate for an all-SIMD launch containing exactly one physical program.

result_dependency_system_cycles.description: Additional latency per dynamic TTIR atomic invocation when its returned old value is consumed.

unknown_contention_multiplier.description: Route-relative conservative multiplier when TTIR cannot prove the runtime address collision distribution.

camodel_effective.description: Workload-effective CaModel rates retained as fallback calibration context.

description.description: Human-readable warning that only part of this block is currently consumed.

scope.description: Workload and active-vector-core scope from which these effective rates were derived.

simulator_clock_mhz.description: Clock used by the simulator-cycle measurements before conversion to SYS_CNT cycles.

conversion.description: Documentary formula used to convert aggregate simulator-cycle rates into SYS_CNT-cycle rates; not evaluated by the loader.

warp_size.description: Warp size assumed by the CaModel workload. The current loader uses simt.warp_size_measurement instead.

source.description: CaModel artifact and profiling run that produced these workload-effective rates.

confidence.description: Documentary confidence of the complete CaModel workload-effective block; the current loader does not propagate it to predicate-cost confidence or the gate.

note.description: Warning that these values include workload dependencies and stalls and are not isolated peak rates.

camodel_rates.description: Workload-effective aggregate warp-instruction issue rates in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle. The current loader consumes only predicate.

memory.description: Effective memory warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

float_alu.description: Effective floating-point ALU warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

shuffle.description: Effective shuffle warp-instruction rate; isolated shared measurement is used instead.

predicate.description: Effective predicate warp-instruction rate consumed to estimate mask predicate cycles.

control.description: Effective control warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

int_alu.description: Effective integer-ALU warp-instruction rate; retained as context and not currently consumed.

confidence.description: Evidence confidence ordered as none < low < medium < high.

coverage.description: Feature-domain admission bounds for trusting Event-calibrated ranking residuals.

description.description: Meaning of these thresholds and warning that they are model-validity limits, not hardware limits.

minimum_irregular_density.description: Minimum value of the current rank-based pointer irregularity proxy required by calibrated irregular domains. The proxy is rank>1 pointer-operation count divided by unique ranked tensor-shape count across tt.addptr/tt.load/tt.store; it does not inspect actual address strides or lane dependence.

tiny_dot_flops_max.description: Maximum dot FLOP count admitted to the tiny-gather-dot calibration domain.

tiny_dot_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the tiny-gather-dot calibration domain.

rowwise_loop_trip_sum_max.description: Maximum sum of statically known loop trip counts admitted to rowwise and rank-1 calibrated domains.

rowwise_mask_rank_sum_max.description: Maximum sum of ranks of mask-producing tensor expressions admitted to the masked-rowwise calibration domain.

rowwise_weighted_reductions_max.description: Maximum loop-execution-weighted tt.reduce count admitted to the masked-rowwise calibration domain. Each reduce contributes the product of its enclosing static scf.for trip counts.

rowwise_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the masked-rowwise calibration domain. This is bounded by the largest calibrated per-program tensor and must not be widened merely to make a new workload pass admission.

rank1_weighted_reductions_max.description: Maximum loop-execution-weighted tt.reduce count admitted to the rank-1 indirect vector-reduction domain. Each reduce contributes the product of its enclosing static scf.for trip counts.

rank1_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the rank-1 indirect vector-reduction domain.

triangular_loop_count_max.description: Maximum number of sibling 16x16 recurrence loops inside the one materializable triangular-solve scope. BT64 has four.

triangular_loop_trip_sum_max.description: Maximum structurally modeled recurrence trip sum in the triangular-solve domain. A full BT64 tile is 4 * (16 - 2) = 56.

triangular_mask_rank_sum_max.description: Maximum unweighted mask-rank sum admitted to the triangular-solve calibration domain.

triangular_weighted_reductions_max.description: Maximum loop-execution-weighted tt.reduce count for one BT64 triangular-solve scope.

triangular_max_tensor_numel.description: Maximum tensor element count admitted to the 16x16 triangular recurrence calibration domain.

dot_model.description: Fixed setup plus throughput model for dot work.

description.description: Human-readable role and execution mode of this dot model.

startup_system_cycles.description: Fixed dot setup cost in SYS_CNT cycles.

flops_per_system_cycle.description: Modeled dot arithmetic rate in FLOP per SYS_CNT cycle.

flops_per_system_cycle_by_active_warp_co.description: Aggregate accumulator-feedback dependent-dot FLOP/SYS_CNT rate selected by physical active-warp count for loop-carried dot recurrence Stages. Points must come from structural occupancy sweeps, not operator names.

generic_completion_scale.description: Completion-envelope scale applied to wholly generic SIMT dot work. A partially matched Stage converts its unmatched residual to partial_composite_residual_scale.

generic_completion_scale_evidence.description: Fresh cross-shape evidence and the admissible range for generic_completion_scale.

partial_composite_residual_scale.description: Completion-envelope scale for generic dot work left after at least one exact operand-path composite matched the same whole-SIMT Stage.

partial_composite_residual_scale_evidenc.description: Fresh structural evidence and admissible range for partial_composite_residual_scale.

source.description: Origin and intended refinement path for the dot prior.

confidence.description: Confidence of this dot prior; when dot work exists, it contributes to the resource-confidence minimum used by the gate.

event_route_domain.description: One bounded workload-structure domain. Multipliers preserve feature-sensitive raw scores while correcting route-relative residual error.

all_simd.description: Multiplier for the raw all-SIMD score.

all_simt_only.description: Multiplier for the raw all-SIMT score.

mixed_simd_simt.description: Multiplier for the raw mixed score.

all_simt_only_validated.description: True only when the BackendConditional whole-kernel pure-SIMT route passed correctness in this bounded domain. It cannot promote an Unsupported or AliasesMixed route.

mixed_simd_simt_validated.description: True only when C++ anchor materialization, BiShengIR compilation, and correctness passed for the local-scope mixed route in this bounded domain. False demotes the otherwise structurally Native mixed candidate.

source.description: Exact shape/config, timing protocol, medians, and correctness result used to fit the multipliers.

event_route_score_multiplier.description: Versioned Event residuals applied after analytical/structural scoring and before legal-candidate ranking.

description.description: Formula, evidence boundary, and report visibility of the route multipliers.

domains.description: Map from calibration-domain name to independently measured route corrections.

kernel_timing.description: Kernel-boundary residual and SYS_CNT conversion. Boundary curves may be separated by execution route and SuperBlock factor when independent minimal-kernel evidence shows different scalar/control shells.

boundary_residual_system_cycles_by_physi.description: Measured residual after subtracting the minimal kernel's modeled Stage resource score, keyed by the number of physical programs launched.

boundary_residual_system_cycles_by_route.description: Measured minimal-kernel residual after subtracting the route resource score, keyed by route, SuperBlock factor, and physical program count.

global_load_boundary_residual_system_cyc.description: One-time residual for kernels containing at least one global load, relative to the minimal store-only boundary kernel and keyed by selected route.

runtime_argument_setup_by_route.description: Route-specific one-time runtime kernel-argument setup envelope.

scalarized_rank2_indirect_load_completio.description: Generic SIMD completion residual for tiny rank-2 loaded-index tiles lowered as nested scalar loops.

simd_rank2_strided_direct_load_completio.description: Bounded whole-SIMD completion residual for one-program direct rank-2 loads whose inner stride is not proven contiguous.

simt_rank2_strided_direct_load_completio.description: Bounded whole-SIMT route-resource target for one-program direct rank-2 loads whose inner stride is not proven contiguous.

rank2_interleaved_prefix_scan_completion.description: Bounded complete-route target for one direct rank-2 load/add-prefix-scan/store chain with row-major interleaved independent sequences.

simt_static_loop_direct_memory_completio.description: Production-mode elapsed target for one bounded pointer-induction loop containing masked direct contiguous FP32 loads and one dependent store. Selection uses only static trip count, compiler vector width, access count and SuperBlock factor.

simt_rank2_indirect_load_completion.description: Signed whole-SIMT completion adjustment for a tiny rank-2 loaded-index tile, keyed by compiler-derived source element bit width and tile elements.

subwarp_indirect_composite_completion.description: Completion residual for a sub-warp loaded-index gather composed with profiled tensor arithmetic.

simd_multi_result_prefix_scan_completion.description: Completion-inclusive SIMD elapsed formula for a bounded multi-result prefix-scan lowering, selected only by TTIR scan geometry, source program count, and the active axis recovered from adjacent masked row-major memory accesses.

simt_pairwise_selection_network_completi.description: Completion-inclusive whole-SIMT route-resource formula for a bounded straight-line pairwise selection network, matched by rank-2 input/output geometry and repeated extent-2 reduction stages.

simd_large_sequence_minmax_scan_completi.description: Bounded completion tail for one-program whole-SIMD straight-line single-result min/max scans with many independent sequences.

simt_multi_sequence_minmax_scan_completi.description: Bounded shared-helper completion reduction for one-program whole-SIMT straight-line single-result min/max scans with multiple independent sequences.

simd_straight_line_add_reduction_complet.description: Shared completion-envelope transfer for one-program whole-SIMD straight-line single-result additive row reductions, selected by the tt.reduce combine region and bounded row/extent geometry.

simd_two_loop_single_reduction_completio.description: Serialized runtime-wave completion envelope for a whole-SIMD route containing exactly two independent straight-line loop stages and one large additive row reduction.

tiny_straight_line_simt_memory_completio.description: Signed route-envelope completion for a one-program whole-SIMT straight-line kernel with one bounded load and one bounded store and no complex collective or memory structure.

simt_non_affine_rank1_memory_completion.description: Signed whole-SIMT completion curve for a bounded rank-one load whose address DAG contains non-affine floating-point index computation, keyed by source logical program count.

shared_local_load_instructions_per_acces.description: Post-TTIR LDS work per matched semantic access.

shared_local_store_instructions_per_acce.description: Post-TTIR STS work per matched semantic access.

private_stack_load_instructions_per_acce.description: Post-TTIR LDK work per matched semantic access.

private_stack_store_instructions_per_acc.description: Post-TTIR STK work per matched semantic access.

synchronization_system_cycles_per_access.description: Measured SIMT thread-block rendezvous cost per matched access.

includes_shared_layout.description: The memory envelope already covers its source layout exchange; do not charge a separate exchange.

mixed_setup_fallback_entry.description: One low-confidence mixed setup fallback for a measured warp count.

description.description: Human-readable warp-count scope and evidence limitation of this fallback entry.

measurement.description: Shared measurement key for the standalone empty-VF harness proxy in SYS_CNT cycles.

empty_simt_setup_system_cycles.description: Inline mixed setup fallback supported by the loader.

mixed_setup_fallbacks.description: Map from warp count to low-confidence mixed setup fallback. The referenced probes contain no SIMD Stage and are not directional transition measurements.

confidence.description: Required Route Model confidence for using these standalone empty-VF probes as mixed setup fallbacks.

note.description: Required warning that true directional switching and dependent hand-off costs remain unmeasured.

op_profile.description: One SIMD or SIMT operation-cost rule.

description.description: Operation-specific provenance and interpretation of this rule.

throughput_measurement.description: Key of a throughput measurement in microbenchmark_profile.

throughput_vector_instructions_per_syste.description: Inline SIMD vector-instruction throughput fallback in vector instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

throughput_scalar_ops_per_system_cycle.description: Inline SIMT scalar-operation throughput fallback in scalar lane operations per SYS_CNT cycle.

relative_to.description: Operation name whose resolved throughput supplies the base cycle estimate.

factor.description: Multiplier applied to the resolved base cycle estimate; values above one make this operation slower.

startup_system_cycles.description: Fixed completion cost for each semantic operation instance.

free_work_units.description: Work units covered by the startup term before the throughput slope applies.

minimum_startup_elements.description: Minimum logical elements in one semantic operation instance before startup_system_cycles applies.

grid_stride_kernel_startup_system_cycles.description: One-time completion startup of this operation's dynamic grid-stride lowering; route composition pays it once per kernel.

includes_local_scope_handoff.description: Whether this semantic completion curve already includes the fixed local-SIMT scope enter/exit envelope.

confidence.description: Confidence of this measured or relative operation rule; when the operation occurs, it contributes to the resource-confidence minimum used by the gate.

masked_strided_copy_completion_map.description: Bounded completion floors keyed by the byte stride of the rank-one strided side of a masked FP32 copy.

op_profiles.description: Map from semantic operation name to either a shared throughput measurement or a cycle multiplier relative to another operation.

selection_calibration.description: Cost parameters used by stage formulas. This object contains no online route-admission policy.

description.description: Human-readable role and evidence boundary of the complete calibration object.

source.description: Workloads, measurements, and rollout boundary from which the route-specific calibration was derived. It is loaded into profile metadata but currently does not affect scoring or reports.

tiny_dot_flops_max.description: Tiny-dot formula-domain threshold consumed by the current Stage partitioner; null disables the structural threshold in unsupported profiles.

simd_memory.description: All-SIMD memory rates and their model-specific provenance.

description.description: Human-readable role and consumption boundary of these rates.

hbm_bytes_per_system_cycle.description: Legacy whole-device HBM-rate seed in byte/SYS_CNT-cycle; currently not consumed by Route Model scoring.

vector_mte2_bytes_per_system_cycle.description: All-SIMD load-path rate in byte/SYS_CNT-cycle; load cycles equal load bytes divided by this value.

mte3_bytes_per_system_cycle.description: All-SIMD store-path rate in byte/SYS_CNT-cycle; store cycles equal store bytes divided by this value.

source.description: Origin and validity caveat of these model-specific rates.

confidence.description: Confidence of the all-SIMD memory rates; when load or store work exists, it contributes to the resource-confidence minimum used by the gate.

note.description: Warning that these are fallback Route Model inputs rather than shared isolated measurements.

computed_address_scalarized_load.description: Completion service for SIMD tensor loads whose non-affine floating-point address DAG lowers to scalar lane service.

control_flow_address_scalarized_load.description: Bounded residual completion curve for SIMD FP32 tensor loads whose rank-one address is selected by scalar control flow and lowered to scalar lane service.

masked_load_store_read_modify_write.description: Bounded SIMD residual surface for a rank-two FP16 masked load/store group whose store value depends on a load guarded by the same mask and whose backend lowering reads the destination before merge/store.

description.description: Human-readable role of the all-SIMD model.

vector_width_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for physical SIMD vector width in bits.

vector_width_bits.description: Inline SIMD vector-width fallback supported by the loader when no measurement key is provided.

simd_reduction.description: Measured source-level SIMD row-reduction startup and lane-step throughput.

simd_sort.description: Bounded native SIMD sort completion surface keyed by semantic rows, axis extent and element width.

simd_startup.description: Legacy all-SIMD startup priors in SYS_CNT cycles.

description.description: Human-readable status and current consumption boundary of these startup priors.

vector.description: Fixed all-SIMD vector setup cost in SYS_CNT cycles; this is the only startup value currently consumed.

mte2.description: Legacy MTE2 startup prior in SYS_CNT cycles; currently not consumed by Route Model scoring.

mte3.description: Legacy MTE3 startup prior in SYS_CNT cycles; currently not consumed by Route Model scoring.

confidence.description: Documentary confidence of the legacy startup priors; the current Route Model loader does not consume it.

note.description: Evidence caveat retained for human review; not consumed by scoring.

simt_memory.description: SIMT GM load/store warp-instruction issue-rate inputs.

description.description: Human-readable meaning and source boundary of the SIMT memory rates.

load_throughput_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for GM-load throughput in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

store_throughput_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for GM-store throughput in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

load_warp_instructions_per_system_cycle.description: Inline GM-load throughput fallback supported by the loader.

store_warp_instructions_per_system_cycle.description: Inline GM-store throughput fallback supported by the loader.

confidence.description: Optional explicit SIMT-memory confidence; otherwise the lower confidence of the referenced load/store measurements is used when memory work exists.

simt_model.description: All-SIMT resources plus mixed-mode setup evidence.

description.description: Human-readable role of the all-SIMT and mixed-mode inputs.

warp_size_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for the number of scalar lanes in one SIMT warp.

warp_size.description: Inline warp-size fallback supported by the loader when no measurement key is provided.

description.description: Human-readable meaning and source boundary of the setup cost.

empty_launch_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for standalone empty-SIMT setup in SYS_CNT cycles.

empty_launch.description: Inline empty-SIMT setup fallback in SYS_CNT cycles.

description.description: Human-readable meaning and source boundary of the shuffle rate.

throughput_measurement.description: Shared measurement key for shuffle throughput in warp instructions per SYS_CNT cycle.

warp_instructions_per_system_cycle.description: Inline shuffle-throughput fallback supported by the loader.

confidence.description: Optional explicit shuffle confidence; otherwise confidence is inherited from the referenced shared measurement and contributes to the gate when shuffle work exists.

simt_source_fit.description: Optional non-negative offline fit from TTIR source facts to generated instruction work.

unroll_factor_weight.description: Optional weight for effective backend unroll excess (unroll factor minus one).

stage_resources.description: Generic mode-specific resources consumed by StageCostModel formulas; no workload name or shape is permitted here.

operations.description: Operation-and-dtype overrides keyed as kind.dtype, for example fadd.f32.

dot_component_private_stack_floors.description: Conditional whole-SIMT private-stack floors keyed only by a function-wide dot-DAG component signature and concrete active-warp/SuperBlock groups.

dot_use_signature.description: Canonical function-wide dot dependency and observable use-context signature; contains no operation names or source locations.

dot_operand_paths.description: Whole-SIMT FMA-dot composite per-physical-group coefficients. Keys encode TTIR operand provenance, layout and launch domain. Includes input GM/shared transfers; not a private-stack model.

dot_store_shared_layout.description: SIMT FMA accumulator to row-major shared-layout group costs, keyed by measured shape/dtype/base warps/factor.

fit_evidence.description: Audit metadata for source-to-generated-instruction fits promoted from offline CaModel/assembly evidence.

generated_vector_traffic.description: Optional post-TTIR LDS/STS and LDK/STK instruction rates. Zero or absent entries fall back to aggregate RVECLD/RVECST rates.

grid_stride_loop.description: Resource curves for a dynamic source grid-stride loop. These curves serialize source-loop bodies and do not assert pipeline overlap.

load_element_system_cycle_measurements.description: Completion-exclusive SIMD loaded-index load service keyed by active scalarized elements, preserving sub-warp occupancy.

store_system_cycle_measurements.description: Completion-exclusive FP32 loaded-index store service keyed by distinct destination segment count.

segmented_load_group_system_cycle_measur.description: Completion-exclusive FP16 loaded-index service keyed by SuperBlock factor, distinct segments, and contiguous elements per segment.

segmented_load_fp32_group_system_cycle_m.description: Completion-exclusive FP32 loaded-index service keyed by SuperBlock factor, distinct segments, and contiguous elements per segment.

issue_instructions_per_system_cycle_meas.description: Microbenchmark key used to audit the effective issue-floor value.

mixed_parent_memory_completion.description: Generic high-wave memory completion envelope for the SIMD AIC parent of a Mixed route. Inputs are compiler-derived parent loop iterations and tile-memory bytes per logical program.

straight_line_completion_by_combine.description: Completion-inclusive straight-line scan helper curves keyed by structural TTIR combine class.

register_budget_per_thread.description: SIMT register budget per thread in 32-bit register units before allocator spill.

rowwise_reduction.description: Bounded completion surfaces for a structural TTIR row-reduction primitive. Keys are SuperBlock factor, independent rows and contiguous reduction extent; operator and kernel names are forbidden.

operation_count_surfaces.description: Additional bounded surfaces keyed by the exact number of TTIR reduction operations.

multi_result_reduction.description: Bounded whole-SIMT completion surface for a multi-result tt.reduce. Selection uses padded axis extent, tail alignment class and independent rows; operator and kernel names are forbidden.

two_pass_rowwise_completion.description: Bounded route-composition residual for exactly two FP16 segmented loaded-index row reads plus one row reduction and no dot. Dimensions are SuperBlock factor, contiguous row extent and runtime programs per scheduling slot Q.

cv_cross_core_synchronization_system_cyc.description: Completion-inclusive AIC/AIV coordination cost added once per physical local-SIMT scope group when CV lowering uses more than one AIV subblock.

cv_partition_payload_efficiency.description: Target-wide fraction of ideal CV payload speedup. One is a perfectly balanced 1:N split; zero retains the unpartitioned payload cost. Calibrate with structural CV probes, never an operator or exact shape.

fixed_pair_measurement.description: Measurement key in the shared microbenchmark profile for one complete local scope pair.

fixed_pair_system_cycles.description: Fixed system-cycle cost of one complete local SIMD-to-SIMT-to-SIMD scope pair.

fixed_scope_measurement.description: Shared microbenchmark key for the completion-inclusive AIV-only local scope enter/leave envelope.

spill_transaction_coverage.description: Calibrated spill transactions generated per excess 32-bit register unit.

usable_ub_bytes.description: Target UB capacity available to one physical SIMT group. A known dot working set is multiplied by the SuperBlock factor and must fit this capacity.

whole_simd_completion_curves.description: Bounded completion curves for an exact whole-SIMD dot/use topology. Entry/store saturation, recurrence setup and the branched dot DAG are structural terms; operator and shape names are forbidden.

whole_simt_completion_curves.description: Completion-inclusive entry and final-drain curves for an exact whole-SIMT dot/use topology and launch shape. Runtime group count and row stride are structural variables; operator names and source locations are forbidden.

description: Target-specific hardware resource profile consumed by the online Stage Cost Model. Stage partitions and workloads are derived from transformed TTIR.

simt_indirect_store_model.description: Optional Ascend950PR indirect memory model in SYS_CNT ticks. Final unmasked and masked models retain their measured-domain guards; unsupported inputs use upstream resource pricing. SIMD reuse requires explicit workload evidence. SIMT random mask requires its configured density prior.

simd_indirect_store_model.description: Optional Ascend950PR indirect memory model in SYS_CNT ticks. Final unmasked and masked models retain their measured-domain guards; unsupported inputs use upstream resource pricing. SIMD reuse requires explicit workload evidence. SIMT random mask requires its configured density prior.

simt_indirect_load_model.description: Optional Ascend950PR indirect memory model in SYS_CNT ticks. Final unmasked and masked models retain their measured-domain guards; unsupported inputs use upstream resource pricing. SIMD reuse requires explicit workload evidence. SIMT random mask requires its configured density prior.

simd_indirect_load_model.description: Optional Ascend950PR indirect memory model in SYS_CNT ticks. Final unmasked and masked models retain their measured-domain guards; unsupported inputs use upstream resource pricing. SIMD reuse requires explicit workload evidence. SIMT random mask requires its configured density prior.

$schema.description: Relative path to this JSON Schema; used by editors and offline validators, not by Route Model scoring.

compatible_targets.description: Additional wildcard target aliases accepted by the target-compatibility gate.

items.description: One case-insensitive wildcard target pattern; '*' and '?' are supported.

description.description: Human-readable ownership boundary and purpose of this Route Model profile.

indirect_memory_profile.description: Relative path to validated indirect-memory model parameters.

microbenchmark_profile.description: Path, relative to this file, to the model-neutral hardware measurement profile.

profile_version.description: Version identifier accepted by the C++ Route Model loader and emitted in decision reports.

schema_version.description: Machine-readable Stage Route Model hardware-profile layout. Version 19 replaces exact-signature route elapsed/completion fits with one generic Stage resource formula and a route-independent kernel boundary.

score_unit.description: Unit label for candidate scores and absolute prediction input. Values are generic SYS_CNT resource-cycle estimates before the route-independent kernel boundary is added.

target.description: Canonical target for this calibration; it must equal the target of the referenced shared microbenchmark profile.
